notes.title: Announcing new price
notes.content:
Howdy everyone.

Blood will be Spilled was released on May 29 2019 which means the game celebrated its 3rd anniversary recently. It was the first project of our very small studio, created with no prior experiences in game development. We learned an incredible amount of stuff on this game, both from our successes and our failures and despite its multiple shortcomings, we are quite proud of what we’ve achieved. The game won multiple awards and was praised for its visuals and narrative, which for us - graphic designers by trade, means a lot.

But it’s been three years and the game is reaching the end of its life cycle. Since we have a completely new team now (including programming), we are no longer able to provide support or fixes for the game. We are aware of the issues that still remain in the game, but from our knowledge, most of them can be solved by reloading a checkpoint or level, even though we understand it’s not ideal.

As of today, we are issuing a permanent price drop for the game on all platforms. We will also continue to offer discounts for the game, so if you wish to try it out, keep an eye out for those. 

We thank everyone who played our game so far and to everyone who shared their feedback with us, it means a great deal to us. 

If you are interested in what the future holds for us next, you can [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1982940/HeistGeist/]check out our new project[/url].

notes.title: Some exciting news!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32948116/fa9c83cb00616a71823dc25a85e85e30d82a7bf9.jpg[/img]

Hi there cowboys! Hope you’re doing great. We have a few news that we wanted to share with you.

[h1]Mac Version[/h1]
It took us a while, but Blood will be Spilled is finally also available on Mac! Since none of us in the team is a Mac user, there is a very slight chance of some platform specific issues that we haven’t yet encountered. In case you would stumble upon any, just let us know at howdy@bloodwillbespilled.com and we’ll look into them right away.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32948116/dcb36ef15923d5a863f5533e441fd684458c0c1c.jpg[/img]

[h1]We’ve won an award![/h1]
Last weekend, Central and Eastern European Game Awards were giving out awards to the best games in certain categories that came out in this region. Our game was nominated in 2 categories - Visual Art and Best Narrative. Even getting nominated along other great games was a huge deal for us (just a reminder, we’re a team of 3 people). So you can probably imagine how happy we were when we won the actual award in the Visual Art category!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32948116/88501c8134e5e1dee72731b3abf264844f0df8a9.jpg[/img]

[h1]Patch 1.2[/h1]
Not so long ago, the game has been patched to 1.2 version. In case you missed it,  [url=https://steamcommunity.com/gid/103582791462469524/announcements/detail/3171022883785517519] the patch notes can be found here[/url].

[h1]Celebratory discount[/h1]
To celebrate all this, there will be a special promotion starting today at 7PM CET. Until November 4th  you’ll be able to buy Blood will be Spilled with a [b]35% discount[/b]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32948116/6729013401d63618396d90fb8af32fde962bfa46.jpg[/img]

[h1]Artbook in the works[/h1]
In other news, we are also working on finishing up the art book. It will look something like this, should be available in digital and also in very limited quantity in print. We hope to have it ready before christmas.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32948116/51a684823db7c08c94469bd0f12fd71d98904df7.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Bugfixes in progress, please be patient
notes.content:
Hi everyone,
without further ado, we say it plainly: "At this point, we failed the release pretty bad!" We are making this game for 5 years already and we presented and tested it publicly many times before. We worked very hard and insane hours to meet the original release date and still made the game exactly the way we wanted. And we really thought that it's possible and we could do it without any bigger issues. We wouldn't release the game if we thought otherwise. We are inexperienced and naive.

As we are a very small team of hobby indie developers with no previous experience in game development, we have very limited resources, also our user beta testing was limited, apparently inadequate and it seems that we were not able to find (not even nearly) most of the bugs that blowed up right after the release to the public. 

We are very sorry and we apologise to everyone who already bought the game and didn't like it. It's completely understandable if you feel it didn't meet your expectations and want to issue a refund if it's still possible. Once again we are very sorry. Blood was spilled pretty bad on our side this time.
 
That being said, most of the bugs and issues is not very serious and hopefully we are able to fix them as soon as possible. Even right now we are working very hard to fix all the issues that we missed and to get the game to the appropriate state. We are going to post updates very frequently so please have your auto update enabled. 

Even if we maybe have no right to do so, we still ask for your patience and trust.

Sincerely
Doublequote studio

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32948116/d5b343ec11393ba420ec5753d0f4ccf6e2ce0953.png[/img]

notes.title: Blood will be Spilled is out now!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32948116/891633a7e8efdcaf9e07e834baf67f8853eb179e.png[/img]

Howdy fellow gunslingers, outlaws and desperados,
after almost 5 years in development, the game is finally out and ready for you to shoot some of the annoying insects on your journey to revenge!

We really hope that you'll all enjoy wandering with Jack through this hand-drawn harsh Wild West world full of strange allies, deadly enemies and other rather peculiar characters. That you'll count every bullet on the way through dusty canyons and deserts and make all of the bad guys pay for what they did to him.

As we didn't want to disappoint our few fellow fans, we really wanted to release the game in time. Unfortunately, very short before the original release date, we encountered one pretty serious problem that made us to postpone the launch of the game. We are sorry for that and really thankful for your patience and support. As a thanks to our fans, we are launching the game with 10% discount.

The game itself still deserves a bit of an aesthetical polish here and there. Also difficulty balancing of the combat and scoring still requires a little tuning. We'll keep working on the game in following days and weeks to get it into its best shape possible. Also with your help and feedback.

We are a small team of (mostly) three ambitious yet quite inexperienced developers, with very limited resources, making our first game. For us, it was an incredible adventure full of hard work and great moments. We put our hearts and souls into this game, made lots of bad decisions and almost every mistake you could imagine, still trying to deliver the best game that we always wanted to make.

Since hunting and killing bugs is what we do for a living now, as it usually is with games, you might encounter a bug or two yourself. If (when) this happens, please contact us and send it our way and we will do our best to solve that problem for good as soon as possible.
 
Also, we would be really grateful if you could help us by sharing the news with your friends and giving us a positive review.

Cheers, and don’t forget to keep your gun clean and your powder dry,
Doublequote Studio

notes.title: Postponing the release date
notes.content:
Howdy cowboys! Unfortunately, we have some bad news. Due to unforeseen complications in the last days leading up the release of Blood will be Spilled, we stumbled upon few issues that made us reconsider our release date. We were really working our hardest to get it all done in time, so that we wouldn’t need to postpone the time of the release, but we’re just a very small team of three and a half people. And we didn’t want to disappoint those few fans we have by releasing the game in a state that we’re not happy with. It was a choice between two evils and we hope we chose the lesser one.

[b]So, without further ado, the new, postponed release date is on Wednesday May 29th 2019. We would really like to apologize to any people we disappointed, but we simply ask you to wait just a little bit longer. [/b]

Thank you very much for your support and hopefully see you all next week.

Sincerely,
Doublequote Studio Team

notes.title: Please don't shoot us (yet)
notes.content:
Howdy fellow gunslingers!

It seems that there was a communication hiccup about the release date of the game. It's our fault and we are really sorry for that.

About a year ago, when we started our coming soon page, we set our approximate release date as Q1 2019. But as it goes in game development, we are very slightly behind the schedule.
Somehow in the meantime Steam added the official release date automatically as April the 1st. We were not aware that it was publicly visible and now we are looking like true April fools.

As for the lack of communication from our side, we are very small team of almost 3 people making our first game. We are mainly focusing very hard to finish the game as soon as possible so there is sadly very little time for marketing and communication. Right now we are making final polishing of the game, so we didn't want to announce the official release date until we are 100% sure. 

[b]That being said, we are going to announce the release date in the following weeks with some additional info. So stay tunned.[/b]

So please don't shoot us... and in the meantime you can follow us on twitter or instagram.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32948116/88e520d49672c71664d1f94b33410f1242077e79.jpg[/img]
